_comment: Tier-2 for fenics stokes#: confirms the catalog's basix.ufl element-construction strings work in dolfinx 0.10. Taylor-Hood (P2v + P1), MINI (P1v + Bubble degree gdim+1, enriched, mixed with P1), and equal-order P1/P1 all construct valid FunctionSpaces. Strict size ordering TH(187) > MINI(139) > P1/P1(75) on the 4x4 unit-square triangulation. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (dolfinx 0.10.0, basix 0.10.0). MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): a degree-1 velocity space makes the mixed dimension measure 75 instead of 187 and breaks the strict ordering (75 > 139 is False), so 'taylor_hood_dim=187' and 'dim_ordering_th_gt_mini_gt_eq=True' go missing and the fixture's own ERROR line trips the forbid list. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.

_mutation.note: Antidote: build the 'Taylor-Hood' velocity space at degree 1 instead of 2 — the classic mistake of calling an equal-order P1/P1 pair Taylor-Hood. Every construction still succeeds and every dimension is still measured from a real FunctionSpace; the numbers simply change.
